Instructions: """ Analyze the following details of user financial profile: Name: Input: Account.Name Monthly Income: Input: Account.Monthly_Income__c Monthly Savings: Input: Account.Monthly_Savings__c Monthly Expenses: Entertainment: Input: Account.Entertainment__c Food: Input: Account.Food__c Health: Input: Account.Health__c Other Expenses: Input: Account.Other_Expenses__c
Generate an engaging and friendly response that: 1. Highlight's the customer current saving pattern and expense distribution 2. Gives 2-3 investment recommendations suitable for their financial situation like stocks, mutual funds, fixed deposits, SIPs, Gold, Land, etc... with some names of stocks, mutual funds, FD schemes, SIP schemes and platforms, land area name, Gold time to buy if possible but only 2-3 investment recommendations. 3. Provide suggestions if there is scope to reduce the expenditures 4. Keep the tone helpful and optimistic 5. Limit the response to 600 words maximum.
"""
